title: Library Return and Sorting Corner
description: Static library return-and-sorting corner with three distinct visual work zones: a public-facing return counter with a complete closed three-book kit, a perpendicular sorting counter with another complete three-book kit beside an empty holding bookcase, and a complete empty book cart parked by the transfer exit. Six unit-scale rigid instances preserve four original verified asset IDs, every original mesh, hierarchy and full solid PBR. One scene-only closed floor supports the furniture; each complete book kit has all three cover undersides supported by its counter. Eight finite public/staff/shelf/transfer reference volumes remain empty. One scene and zero new independent models. The empty cart and bookcase deliberately make no loaded cart or general book-fit claim. Static appearance only: no borrowing/returning software, animation, insertion, cart motion, continuous navigation, ergonomics, actual accessibility/code compliance, load, stability, manufacture or safety certification.
